The watch screen is divided into an invisible 3×3 grid:

 [ 1 ][ 2 ][ 3 ]

Tap the grid zones to enter your code. There is no visual feedback.

The system checks after every tap using a sliding window — as long as your code appears anywhere in your recent taps it will unlock.

Your code must be at least 4 digits and not all the same.

 Short press = dot (·)
